scripts.nginx:up: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml up --build -d nginx
scripts.nginx:down: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml down nginx
scripts.client:up: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml up --build -d client
scripts.client:down: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml down client
